shell_cmds.command: grep -rn "M2 in progress" . 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "---"; grep -rn "Status:" README.md | head
git diff README.md; echo "---"; git log --oneline -3 -- README.md
ls _ai_/bench/timing/logs/ 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "M2 in progress" _ai_/bench/timing/logs/ 2>/dev/null | head
grep -c "Status: M2 in progress" README.md; grep -c "Status: M2 in progress, M3 next." README.md
grep -rn "M2 in progress" internal/agent/*_test.go | head; echo "---"; grep -rn "talkednotacted" internal/agent/ -l
grep -rn "M2 in progress" .wavez/index.db 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo "---"; ls -la README.md; stat -f "%Sm" README.md 2>/dev/null || stat -c "%y" README.md
